name: Corrupted Lecher
tactics: In combat, corrupted followers spread out, trying to sow discord among as many enemies as possible. They take full advantage of their charming effects to put multiple enemies under their influence. If different types of corrupted are in combat, they might gang up on a single opponent, afflicting him or her with various debilitating effects. Corrupted followers are often subordinate to other creatures. They are obedient and subject to the whims of their masters. A mortal who originally made a deal with infernal powers has little freedom and only scattered memories of his or her former self.

alignment.name: Evil
alignment.description:
Evil creatures don’t necessarily go out of their way to hurt people, but they’re perfectly willing to take advantage of the weakness of others to acquire what they want.
	Evil creatures use rules and order to maximize personal gain. They don’t care whether laws hurt other people. They support institutional structures that give them power, even if that power comes at the expense of others’ freedom. Slavery and rigid caste structures are not only acceptable but desirable to evil creatures, as long as they are in a position to benefit from them.

description: This is the size of a typical human and serves as a standard in the game. This category has no special rules.

traits.name: Focused Carnality
traits.details: The lecher cannot be targeted by an attack unless it is the nearest enemy to an attacker.

hit.description: damage. Choose one of the lecher’s allies within 5 squares of the target. Until the end of the target’s next turn, the target is marked by that creature. In addition, if the target has any creatures marked, those marks end.

powers.name: Spread of Passion
powers.trigger: An enemy reduces the lecher to 0 hit points.

effect.description: The triggering enemy moves its speed as a free action to a square adjacent to its nearest enemy.
